summary.text: PC-ABS is a blend of polycarbonate and ABS. Makers sell it for prototyping, tooling, low-volume production and automotive trim, and say it takes metal plating well. Its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 112 °C. On the H2C it prints at 260⁠–⁠280 °C, but some sheets ask for a heated chamber beyond what the H2C reaches, and a maker advises a temperature-controlled chamber for large parts.
